issue.title: Allow overriding UButton's default variant through the app config
issue.body:
### Description

Right now `UButton` always defaults to `variant: 'solid'` unless every single usage passes `variant` explicitly. We'd like to set the default variant once, globally, through `app.config.ts`, the same way the color can be overridden.

### Why

Our design system uses `outline` everywhere and passing `variant="outline"` on every button call site is repetitive and easy to forget.

### Considered alternative

A global wrapper component, but that loses typing and slot forwarding.

I understand this changes the resolved default for anyone relying on the current implicit `solid` default, so it would need to ship as a documented default change rather than a patch.
